comparison.objective: Candidate sets a gripper stop to a specified angle; this record fits opposed tapered shims behind a door jamb until snug without bowing it.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate resists jam-nut torque with a coaxial driver; the record incrementally drives two opposed wedges, senses fit, and balances contact pressure from both wall faces.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks lock retention over actuation cycles; the record checks shim overlap, near-zero free gap, bounded jamb bow, rest, and hand clearance.
comparison.reason: Both preserve a target while securing it, but opposed-wedge fit and jamb straightness test force-balanced insertion rather than coupled threaded countertorque.
